readings: For each constructor that has at least one constructorStandings row, count its constructorStandings records. The average is the mean of those counts across only the constructors that appear in constructorStandings. Return the 10 constructors with the largest positive difference (count minus average), largest first. Show constructorId, nationality, record count, and difference.

For each constructor, count its constructorStandings records. Constructors in the constructors table with no standings rows count as 0. The average is the total number of standings records divided by the number of all constructors in the constructors table. Return the 10 constructors with the largest positive difference (count minus average), largest first. Show constructorId, nationality, record count, and difference.
queries:
SELECT constructorId, nationality, cnt AS record_count, cnt - (SELECT AVG(c) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS c FROM constructorStandings GROUP BY constructorId)) AS difference
FROM (
  SELECT cs.constructorId, c.nationality, COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM constructorStandings cs
  JOIN constructors c ON c.constructorId = cs.constructorId
  GROUP BY cs.constructorId
)
WHERE cnt - (SELECT AVG(c) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS c FROM constructorStandings GROUP BY constructorId)) > 0
ORDER BY difference DESC
LIMIT 10;
SELECT c.constructorId, c.nationality, COUNT(cs.constructorStandingsId) AS record_count,
       COUNT(cs.constructorStandingsId) - (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM constructorStandings) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM constructors) AS difference
FROM constructors c
LEFT JOIN constructorStandings cs ON cs.constructorId = c.constructorId
GROUP BY c.constructorId, c.nationality
HAVING difference > 0
ORDER BY difference DESC
LIMIT 10;
